parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app path per the decision rules. The copy in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' (package: DebugPanel) is the production implementation; the WallpaperSampleApp copy is a local mirror that exists to make the sample app self-contained without taking a hard dependency on the DebugPanel package. Lifting the shared implementation into a common location would couple the sample app's build graph to production infrastructure, which is the exact anti-pattern the sample-app-mirror restraint is designed to prevent.
